text:
Predicates:
PlayingFor(x, y) ::: x plays for y.
Brazilian(x) ::: x is Brazilian.
Nautico(x) ::: x is Nautico.
QuestionedClub(y) ::: y is a football club.

Premises:
AiltonSilva(bornIn1995) ∧ KnownAs(Ailton, Ailton) ::: Ailton Silva, born in 1995, is known as Ailton.
PlayingFor(Ailton, Braga) ::: Ailton was loaned out to Braga.
PlayingFor(Ailton, Nautico) ::: Ailton Silva plays for Nautico.
Brazilian(AiltonSilva) ::: Ailton Silva is Brazilian.
Nautico(x) ∧ Braga(x) ::: Nautico and Braga are football clubs.
Nautico(x) ∧ Fluminense(x) ::: Nautico and Fluminense are football clubs.

Conclusion:
∀x (PlayingFor(x, Nautico) → ¬Brazilian(x)) ::: No one playing for Nautico is Brazilian.
